statuses.name: Bleed
statuses.description: Loses {perTurn} health at the start of each of their turns, for {turns} turns. A second application stacks it once.

statuses.name: Exposed
statuses.description: Takes {taken} percent more damage. Lasts {turns} turns.

statuses.name: Enraged
statuses.description: Deals {dealt} percent more damage and takes {taken} percent more. Cannot be stunned. The sample applies it for the rest of a fight.

statuses.name: Fury
statuses.description: Deals {dealt} percent more damage. Lasts three turns.

statuses.name: Bloodlust
statuses.description: Deals {dealt} percent more damage for the rest of the fight.

statuses.name: Steadfast
statuses.description: Cannot be stunned or Exposed for a short while.
